entities.summary: Jinbōchō Theater  is an arts complex comprising a theatre, cinema and rehearsal space in the Jinbōchō neighbourhood of Chiyoda, Tokyo. Opened on 7 July 2007, the theatre is owned and operated by publishing house Shogakukan.
